title: Organoid Intelligence: From Foundations to Frontier Wetware Computing
description: Comprehensive open-access textbook and research compendium on Organoid Intelligence (OI) and biological wetware computing. Includes: (1) An 82-page human-language beginner's guide with intuitive analogies; (2) A 43-page master technical volume formalizing Causal Logic, Reservoir Computing with Short-Term Plasticity, Inverse Ising Thermodynamics, Topological Chaos (TDA), and Renormalization Group Scaling Laws; (3) Four verified empirical discoveries on live 30kHz FinalSpark organoid electrophysiology datasets (fs369 and fs437); (4) Complete source code, simulation arrays, and 24 high-resolution figures.
